verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents `vastai search offers` as the way to query prices programmatically, with filters such as `rentable=true`. Runtime probes confirm that both the CLI and a bare keyless GET to the public /api/v0/bundles/ REST endpoint return live marketplace offers with per-hour pricing and specs, with no account or API key, so an agent can comparison-shop before any spend. Missing for 10: a first-party documentation quote specifically describing the REST offer-search (bundles) endpoint and its unauthenticated access, which here is shown only by the probe.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the GPU catalog with live pricing and availability from a public or documented endpoint before committing any spend

citations.quote: **CLI**: Use `vastai search offers` to query prices programmatically
vastai search offers 'gpu_name=RTX_4090 num_gpus=1 verified=true direct_port_count>=1 rentable=true' -o 'dlperf_usd-'
searched the LIVE GPU marketplace with NO account and NO API key, returning real RTX 4090 offers with CUDA versions, vCPUs, RAM, disk, and per-hour prices
a bare keyless GET to https://console.vast.ai/api/v0/bundles/ returned live marketplace offers as JSON including `dph_total` (per-GPU-hour price)
